Before you start, here\'s a brief explanation of how Lethe handles contacts and privacy.
You must actively add people – and they must accept you. You cannot see who is or is not on Lethe. This is by design.
Nobody can find you without your permission. Your protection comes first. Lethe is built on a zero-knowledge security concept.
You can invite people via QR code, phone number, or invite link – and add them as a contact.
Please read the privacy policy to the end before continuing.

Privacy Policy – Lethe

1. Controller
The controller responsible for processing your personal data is the operator of the Lethe app.

2. Data Collected
We collect: phone number (as user ID), display name, encrypted messages, and optionally a profile picture and location (for the dating feature).

3. Purpose of Processing
Your data is used exclusively to provide the service: authentication, message delivery, contact management, and optional features (Dating, Live, Creator). No data is processed for advertising purposes.

4. End-to-End Encryption
All messages are transmitted and stored with end-to-end encryption. The server only stores encrypted content and never has access to your plaintext messages.

5. Data Sharing
Your data is not shared with, sold to, or used by third parties for any purpose. We do not run advertising networks and do not sell user data.

6. Contact Visibility
You cannot see who is registered on Lethe. Only you and people you actively add – who also accept you – can communicate with each other. This is a core part of our security concept.

7. Data Retention
Data is stored as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, all personal data associated with it is permanently removed.

8. Your Rights
You have the right to access, correct, delete, and transfer your data, as well as the right to object to its processing. Contact the app operator to exercise these rights.

9. Cookies and Tracking
The app uses no tracking, no advertising, and no third-party analytics or cookies.

10. Changes
Changes to this privacy policy will be communicated within the app. Continued use of the app after such changes constitutes acceptance.

By tapping "Understood", you confirm that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
